question:
A series $LCR$ circuit is tuned to resonance at $\omega_0=1000\,\text{rad/s}$. At resonance, the applied rms voltage is $V_{\text{rms}}=100\,\text{V}$ and the rms current is $I_{\text{rms}}=2\,\text{A}$. The quality factor of the circuit is measured to be $Q=20$.

Determine the inductance $L$ and the capacitance $C$ of the circuit. (Assume the resistance is frequency independent.)
